text.p: Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy welcomed the nomination on Thursday of Madeleine Albright as U.S. secretary of state, saying she had charmed him when they met at the United Nations.

"We met during deliberations at the United Nations and I was charmed by your personality, intelligence, the friendship you showed us and your nobility," David Levy said in a letter to Albright, currently the United States' U.N. ambassador.
In a letter to Albright released to the media, Levy expressed his hope that he would work with her to advance Middle East peace.
Albright and Senator William Cohen, nominated by President Bill Clinton as defence secretary, are widely regarded in Israel as pro-Israeli.
